from __future__ import annotations

import csv
from io import StringIO

from src.lines import Line


def format_amount(cents: int) -> str:
    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"
    cents = abs(cents)
    return f\"{sign}{cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}\"


def render(lines: list[Line]) -> str:
    output = StringIO(newline=\"\")
    writer = csv.writer(output, lineterminator=\"\\n\")
    writer.writerow([\"account\", \"posted_on\", \"payee\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])
    for line in lines:
        writer.writerow(
            [
                line.account,
                line.posted_on,
                line.payee,
                format_amount(line.amount_cents),
                line.memo,
            ]
        )
    return output.getvalue()

from src.lines import Line
from src.statement import export_statement


def test_usd_payee_with_comma_is_quoted_as_one_csv_field():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line(\"chk-100\", \"2024-06-02\", \"Smith, Jones LLP\", 1250, \"retainer\", \"USD\")]
    )
    assert text == (
        \"account,posted_on,payee,amount,memo\\n\"
        'chk-100,2024-06-02,\"Smith, Jones LLP\",12.50,retainer\\n'
    )
